How to obtain: Plunder (Sea Battle)

Target: Molucca Pirates
Location: The Banda Sea (Southeast Asia)
Fleet: 5 heavy galleons (rare)
Confirmed location: 6204,4948 (northern shore of the top island, east of Run)
Drops/Plunder:
5200 ducats, The Drill of Destruction , Naksin , Hemp Fabric , Lumber

Guide: Sink NPC fleets repeatedly until the rare 5 heavy galleon version of Molucca Pirates spawns. It has appeared twice at the above coordinates but might be found elsewhere in the sea region as well. An aide with Seize Cargo skill is strongly recommended to help plunder this item. The Successful Plundering 1 / Successful Plundering 2 Oxford skills and equipment with Chibcha Golden Dress effect can also help.
